Zorko Group · Franchise investment

Food franchise investment.
Look at the complete picture.

A franchise fee is one part of a business budget. Understand setup costs, working capital and ongoing expenses before comparing food franchise opportunities.

What does a food franchise cost include?

Cost categories to confirm in an individual proposal
CategoryQuestions to ask
Entry and brand feesIs there a franchise fee, deposit or other brand charge? Is it refundable?
Premises and fit-outAre rent, deposits, interiors, utilities and signage included?
Equipment and opening stockWhich equipment, systems, inventory and delivery costs are covered?
Launch and trainingWhat training and opening support is included, and who pays travel or staffing costs?
Recurring expensesWhat charges, supplies, staffing, rent, utilities and marketing costs continue after opening?
Working capitalHow much reserve is needed for the expected operating cycle and slower trading periods?

Comparing affordable and low-investment franchises

If you are researching a food franchise under ₹5 lakh or ₹10 lakh, check whether the advertised amount covers the whole setup or only one component. Ask what is excluded, whether taxes are included and how the estimate changes by location and format.

This guide does not establish that a Zorko format is available within a particular budget. The team confirms current pricing in an individual proposal.

Royalty, margins and payback are different questions

Ask whether recurring fees apply and how they are calculated. A gross margin does not equal net profit: rent, staffing, utilities, delivery charges and other expenses still affect the operating result.

Compare realistic scenarios using documented assumptions. A projected return or payback period is an estimate, not a guaranteed outcome.

Prepare for a useful investment conversation

Bring your city, premises size, ownership or rental status, budget range and intended operating involvement. Request a current scope with inclusions, exclusions, charges and responsibilities clearly separated.
